title: Divide, but loudly
prompt: Write `safeDivide(int a, int b)` that returns `(double) a / b` - but throws `ArithmeticException` with a message containing "zero" when `b` is 0. A caller must be able to *catch* the failure, not discover a silent 0.

tests.name: normal division keeps the fraction
tests.hint: Cast BEFORE dividing: (double) a / b keeps the fraction.

tests.name: zero throws, message says why
tests.hint: Print-and-return-0 is how the bug hides - throw instead.
